Title: Public preview: Azure Purview Data Catalog now supports hierarchical glossary

Body.Content:
With this feature, Azure Purview Data Catalog you can now define parent-child relationship between terms within the business glossary. This gives you the ability to define the same term name in different parents. E.g., Customer term can be present in parent Finance as Finance_Customer and in Sales as Sales_Customer with different term templates and custom attributes.

Learn more.
